pr.body:
Repairs the entity_relationships traversal at the data layer in unified_queries.py.

Context: The dossier (conport-optimal-coverage-and-hardening-analysis-2026-06-16.md §3.1 T0-TRAVERSE) RUNTIME-VERIFIED that the live entity_relationships table has columns source_id (uuid) and target_id (uuid) — not source_item_id / target_item_id. Any CTE referencing the wrong column names would produce a PostgreSQL error at query time. Additionally, ::int casts on uuid values are invalid and must be removed.

This packet's scope is exclusively the data-layer fix in unified_queries.py (get_related_decisions and related CTE helpers). Handler-layer issues (max_depth clamping, int() coercion on query params in enhanced_server.py) are owned by DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-203.

The executing agent must verify actual column names at HEAD against schema.sql / live DB before patching. If the fix was already applied by a prior PR (e.g. #894), the agent records VERIFIED-NO-OP and closes the step with no change to unified_queries.py. Fabricated fixes are not acceptable.
